meta.name: Swerve Women’s Sports
meta.description:
Swerve Women’s Sports showcases premium live events with the fiercest competitors, world-class matches, and riveting stories including US Soccer, Red Bull, World Football Association, Athletes Unlimited Basketball & Volleyball, PFL, Invicta FC, and more.

Shows: Gymnastics: NCAA Championships Super Six [Peng-Peng Lee], Shamrock FC: Best of Women's Division Ep 2, STIHL Timbersports: US Women's Pro Championship 2026, Baddest Babes in MMA: Modafferi vs. Honchak, Baddest Babes in MMA: Phillips vs. Nakamoto
Available on: Pluto TV
